title: Design System: Active Link Automation & Electrical

display.purpose: Hero headline only. Uppercase, one phrase per line, cyan periods.

title.purpose: Service rows and the symptom readout. Audience titles run larger at the same weight.

body.purpose: Running text. Support copy caps at 65ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked instrument labels, including the viewfinder coordinates.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft black lift plus cyan glow under the filled primary button.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: Lift and top sheen on the builder, reviews, and quote-form plates.

shadows.name: pressed-toggle
shadows.purpose: Inset cyan edge and short lift on a system row that is on.

motion.name: tilt
motion.purpose: Camera and diagram tilt. Fine pointer only. Resting camera angle is rotateX(14deg) rotateY(-32deg).

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: Lens sweep across the camera. Removed when reduced motion is set.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Diagram lines settle after a site change.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pressed buttons shift down 1px. Reduced motion removes the shift.

motion.name: reduced
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion stops sweep, tilt follow, settle, and smooth scrolling. The resting camera angle stays.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled cyan call control. On-cyan text, control-lift shadow.
components.html: Call the team
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--cyan); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--cyan); color: #041018; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35), 0 0 22px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7aecff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Ghost-filled cyan-edged control for the second and third actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.72); border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(4, 8, 16, 0.45); color: var(--ink); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-line:hover { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--cyan); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-line:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Quote-form text field. Cyan caret, alert line when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field { width: 16rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.7rem 0.75rem; color: var(--ink); background: #071018; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.45); border-radius: 2px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; caret-color: var(--cyan); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #b7d7e8; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #ffb4bc; }

components.name: HUD Key
components.description: Square site or symptom key. Pressed state fills with cyan.
components.css: .ds-keys { display: flex; gap: 0.45rem; } .ds-key { min-height: 48px; min-width: 5.5rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.4); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }  .ds-key.is-on, .ds-key[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--cyan); color: #041018; border-color: var(--cyan); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header links. Ink at rest, cyan on hover, 44px tall.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.1rem; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--cyan); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Plate
components.description: Frosted plate for the builder, the reviews, and the quote form.
components.css: .ds-plate { max-width: 28rem; padding: 1rem; color: var(--ink); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10, 24, 42, 0.92), rgba(5, 10, 18, 0.94)); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.42); box-shadow: 0 22px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(190, 244, 255, 0.16); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-plate-rating { margin: 0 0 0.35rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-size: 2.4rem; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Closed Badge
components.description: Sunday closed mark. Workshop red fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-closed { display: inline-block; padding: 0.05rem 0.45rem; color: #fff; background: var(--red); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; } .ds-closed:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Header mark. Brand-blue tile, cyan ring, ink center, Plus Jakarta Sans name.
components.html: Active LinkAutomation & Electrical
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-name { display: block; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-brand-sub { display: block; margin-top: 0.1rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; }  .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: System Toggle
components.description: On/off row in the system builder. Pressed row takes a cyan tint, an inset edge, and a filled flag.
components.css: .ds-toggle { width: 18rem; min-height: 48px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.4); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle.is-on { background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1); border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cyan), 0 10px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); } .ds-flag { padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.45); } .ds-toggle.is-on .ds-flag { color: #041018; background: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--cyan); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The Night-Shift Viewfinder is a near-black instrument for a Nilai workshop. The ground is void, the working light is electric cyan, and violet exists only as bloom. Density is one reading column on a 65ch measure, opening to a two-column viewfinder on a wide screen. Plus Jakarta Sans carries every line, from quiet body copy to the heavy uppercase display.

Depth is glass, cyan edge light, and a soft lift. Corner brackets frame the first screen and repeat on the builder plate. The 56px grid and the scan lines stay inside that viewfinder. The camera and the system diagram are CSS and SVG. The map iframe is the only embedded picture, filtered back into the night palette.

The page keeps a dark color scheme and rejects a light cream section, a graphite-and-amber theme, and a smart-home pastel palette. Brand blue stays in the logo mark. Brand red is the Sunday closed badge, and the form also uses that red as the alert wash.
keyCharacteristics: Void ground, cyan working light, violet bloom in two places
Plus Jakarta Sans, 400 body through 800 display
Square HUD keys and circular instrument marks
Glass on the builder, the reviews, and the quote form
Grid and scan lines confined to the hero viewfinder
Lens sweep, tilt, and diagram settle, all stopped for reduced motion

rules.name: The Working Light Rule
rules.body: Electric cyan is the only interactive accent. Every filled cyan control uses on-cyan text. Selection uses the same pair.

rules.name: The Bloom Rule
rules.body: Violet is bloom behind the camera and a wash on the system-builder plate. It is not a second accent for type or controls.

rules.name: The Mark Rule
rules.body: Brand blue belongs to the logo mark. Brand red fills the Sunday closed badge with white text, and the same red at 35% opacity is the form-alert wash. Red is not a button, a link, or a section.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans is the only family. Display and controls are 800. Body is 400. Navigation and form labels are 700. The hero lede is 600. No second family, no italic.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Support copy stays inside 65ch. Display is uppercase and tight. Instrument labels are uppercase and tracked out.

rules.name: The Viewfinder Rule
rules.body: The 56px grid and the camera scan lines belong to the hero viewfinder. The rest of the page is the 1120px column and the breakpoints above, on void or on the night band.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Glass is the system builder, the reviews, and the quote form. Other sections sit flat on void or on the night band. The stuck header and the dock are scrims.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow is a soft black lift, a cyan glow, or a 1px inset sheen. The system has no hard offset shadow.

rules.name: The Square Key Rule
rules.body: Buttons and fields are 2px. HUD keys, plates, the menu toggle, and the dock are square. Circles belong to the lens, the blooms, the pips, and the timeline dots.

dos: Do keep the ground on void, with the night band as the only alternate section ground.
Do put on-cyan text on every filled cyan control, including the primary button, the pressed HUD key, and the dock's Call cell.
Do use Plus Jakarta Sans at the shipped weights: 400 for body, 600 for the hero lede, 700 for navigation and labels, 800 for display and controls.
Do keep the 16px by 2px cyan corner brackets on the viewfinder and on the builder plate.
Do draw the camera and the system diagram in CSS and SVG, and keep partner names as text.
Do stop animation and transitions, and hide the lens sweep, when reduced motion is requested. The camera's resting tilt may stay.
Do keep the focus ring: 2px solid instrument ink, 3px offset.
donts: Don't add a light cream section, a graphite-and-amber theme, or a pastel smart-home palette.
Don't use brand blue outside the logo mark.
Don't use brand red as a theme. The shipped uses are the filled Sunday badge and the form-alert wash.
Don't place violet on type, buttons, or sections beyond the camera bloom and the builder plate.
Don't extend the viewfinder grid or the scan lines past the hero.
Don't make the glass plate the default section container.
Don't replace the CSS camera, the line schematic, or the text partner names with photography or redrawn partner logos.
